Legs.Subject: Rational never reduces a fraction, so its own record equality is not a valid rational-equality test; every identity below is checked by CROSS-MULTIPLICATION instead (a/b = c/d iff a·d = c·b), over eight operand rationals including a zero numerator, negative numerators and a pair wide enough (2^96 over 2^40) to exercise BigInteger growth. The ctor/Numerator/Denominator readback, Two = One + One, the additive identity and inverse (a + 0 = a, a + (-a) = 0, -(-a) = a), the multiplicative identity (a·1 = 1·a = a), and a - b = a + (-b) are asserted for every sample; commutativity of + and ·, and (a / b)·b = a for every nonzero b, over every ordered pair; associativity of + and · and distributivity of · over + over every ordered triple
a + b for every ordered pair of the eight samples, the exact BigInteger result reduced to double
